body: Two research tasks queued behind C55, which is still open and still yours. Order: C55, then C56, then C57 - one session each. C56 THE YOUTH DIVISION - research/TASK_C56.md - predicted-queue item 4; EventResult.age_division is never set and the game has no youth concept. C57 THE SELECTION - research/TASK_C57.md - C52 build order step 3; invite_min_fame is currently the only gate between a fighter and a world bracket. Both are research only: two markdown files each, no code, no test, no HANDOFF.md edit. Each task file carries its own start prompt. Model gpt-5.6-luna, effort high, Fast off. Do not reopen C54's ruling that national_selection is an evidence-gated pure cost; cite it. UNKNOWN is a finding - C54 came back thin on purpose and was better for it.
